name: kb_546_Normalized

schema.description: Local represents directly-attached storage with node affinity (Beta feature)

fsType.description: Filesystem type to mount. It applies only when the Path is a block device. Must be a filesystem type supported by the host operating system. Ex. "ext4", "xfs", "ntfs". The default value is to auto-select a fileystem if unspecified.

path.description: The full path to the volume on the node. It can be either a directory or block device (disk, partition, ...).

description:
The persistent local volume has been configured to use the **ext4** filesystem type. This setting ensures compatibility with the node’s operating system and provides reliable block‑device handling for the attached storage.

The volume is mounted directly from the node at the following location: **/var/lib/kubelet/pods/volume-id**. This path points to the specific directory (or block device) that Kubernetes will use for the pod’s storage needs.
